mission_09: Rule extraction converts opaque neural network decisions into human-readable if-then rules. Two main approaches exist: pedagogical (treating the network as a black box and training a decision tree on its predictions) and decompositional (analyzing internal hidden unit activations). The pedagogical approach measures fidelity — how well the extracted rules approximate the network's behavior. The decompositional approach additionally maps hidden unit rules back to input features using correlation analysis. In this mission, you implement both approaches: training decision trees on neural network outputs for pedagogical extraction, extracting rules from hidden activations for decompositional extraction, parsing tree structures into readable rules, and correlating hidden units with input features to create interpretable mappings.
